slots.summary: Your r/Fencing thread, with the official side filled in: the FIE's Oct 22 warning about the World Fencing League (wording via the South China Morning Post; the full text isn't public), the exact rule (FIE Statutes 1.2.6(b)), what the WFL is, both sides labeled as opinion, and what it means for club fencers.
